caption:
Mountain biking in Costa Rica is rarely about flat, predictable roads; it is about finding the high seams where the cloud forest meets the sky. On these grassy ridges, the elevation shifts the air and the terrain demands a quiet, focused respect. Every route I design for My Adventure Costa Rica is tested on these exact slopes, ensuring we find the true character of the landscape. Our journeys are designed slowly, for those who want to see the country from the trail up.
